**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (confidence 0.83).**

- **Investigation:** Section 17 (term/termination) imposes exit obligations only on us (certify destruction/return of Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes) plus a fee refund on Garman default; Section 8 return of Sparkling's Confidential Information is limited to the pre-acceptance rejection option; Section 16 escrow gives source-code continuity but no exit assistance or data return; Section 18 survival is generic. Searches for transition/assistance/data/return/export/deletion produced no responsive exit clause.
- **Cure:** one inserted Section 17(d) at the preferred level — up to six months' transition assistance at Garman's then-current rates, return of Sparkling's data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return. All six preferred elements are carried by the single insertion; no neighbouring text was rewritten.
